result.summary: The screen is broadly coherent, but several visual defects stand out: a typo in the search placeholder, horizontally clipped restaurant cards without ellipsis, an inconsistent thumbnail background, an inconsistent/low-contrast favorite button, and the bottom card being cut off flush against the tab bar.

issues.description: Search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is hard-clipped at the screen edge: both the image and the title/price text are cut mid-character with no ellipsis, so the label appears broken rather than intentionally peeking.
issues.suggestion: Truncate card titles with ellipsis and apply consistent carousel side padding/peek width so partially visible cards look deliberate, not chopped.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off abruptly by the bottom tab bar, with its title, rating and metadata hidden and no scroll affordance or spacing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the pizza card uses a dark translucent background while the identical button on the ramen card uses a solid white background, creating inconsistent styling and lower icon contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent chip style (e.g. white circle with dark outline heart) for all favorite buttons.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while sibling cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually unbalanced and the white '15–25 min' badge sits on a light background.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds/overlays across cards and add a subtle scrim behind time badges to guarantee contrast.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped so an unnamed chip after 'Healthy' shows only a sliver, offering no hint of what it is.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek so the next chip's label is partially readable, or add a fade/scroll indicator.
